state.situation: An accounts-payable clerk is matching each line of a supplier invoice to the lines of the supplier's purchase orders. invoice is the whole invoice as read; purchase_orders lists every candidate PO in full with every line, what was ordered, already invoiced and what is left. code_conclusions says what the matching code proposed for each invoice line, with its description score out of 100, and whether it is sure; lines it is not sure about are yours to decide. A PO line can be billed in part, one invoice line can draw on lines of several POs, and an invoice line may be on no PO line at all. Judge by what the items are, not by exact wording; quantities, prices and balances are checked separately.
